title: Solana WET presale hijacked by Sybil wallets as HumidiFi resets launch
summary: Bubblemaps CEO Nick Vaiman said Sybil attacks are increasing across presales and airdrops, calling on teams to use KYC or algorithmic detection.

title: Turkish crypto exchange Paribu buys majority stake in competitor CoinMENA
summary: Paribu has bought a majority stake in Dubai- and Bahrain-licensed CoinMENA in a deal valuing the exchange at up to $240 million.

title: Bitcoin's ‘momentum is igniting,’ but these are BTC price levels to watch
summary: Bitcoin market participants saw the yearly open at $93,000 and above as particularly important heading into the weekly close.

title: Cantor slashes Strategy target by 60%, tells clients forced-sale fears are overblown
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald slashed its Strategy price target, but remains bullish on the stock despite fears over potential exclusion by the MSCI Index and forced liquidation concerns, the FT said.

title: Ether vs. Bitcoin teases 170% gains as ETH price breaks 5-month downtrend
summary: Ether price action staged a repeat of its 2021 bull market moves against Bitcoin, leading to predictions of fresh long-term highs against BTC.

title: AlphaTON eyes meme-sized $420.69M raise for TON, AI expansion after baby-shelf exit
summary: AlphaTON exits baby-shelf limits and plans a meme-sized $420.69 million fundraising program despite being a nano-cap with a steep stock decline.

title: Italy sets hard MiCA deadline for crypto platforms to comply
summary: Italy’s markets regulator sets firm MiCA deadlines, forcing VASPs to seek authorization or exit by Dec. 30, and urges investors to check providers’ compliance plans.

title: Ethereum sees 25% validation drop post-Fusaka as Prysm bug nears finality loss
summary: A 25% dip in Ethereum’s voting participation coincided with a bug in the Prysm consensus client shortly after the Fusaka upgrade, with the network just 9% away from losing finality.

title: US investors consider crypto less as risk-taking drops: FINRA study
summary: FINRA found the number of people invested in crypto was steady from 2021 to 2024, but fewer were considering either buying more or investing for the first time.

title: Bitcoin unlikely to replicate January’s surge to new high: 21Shares founder
summary: Bitcoin’s downturn has barely anything to do with “anything crypto specific,” but it’s unlikely to surge early next year, says 21Shares co-founder Ophelia Snyder.
